About Event

​You can still join the online session for Nov16th

​New Participant Session · 9:00–10:30 PM PT

​New here? We'll cover: • What is HarnessRouter • Live demo • Prizes • How to submit

​https://meet.google.com/ukb-uqyc-kei

​---------------------------------------------
📍 Two kickoff hubs on Nov 15. Join the one on your campus, no travel needed.

​🌲 Stanford: Hillel at Stanford (Enter from 564 O'CONNOR LN, Stanford), 2:30-6:30PM

​🐻 Berkeley: Cal Alumni House, UC Berkeley, 10 AM–1 PM PT.

​

​🗓️ Timeline

​▸ Nov 15–19 · Kickoff & build week

​▸ Nov 20 ·Demo Day & Judging

The Big Hack Game Demo Day · Stanford vs Berkeley
Fri, Nov 20 · San Francisco

​Ship an AI agent people pay for.

​The Big Hack Game is the campus showdown before the Big Game: build, launch, and grow an AI product with real users, solve real problems from enterprise teams, and win it for your school.

​🎁 WHAT YOU GET

​💼 Job referrals

​🧑‍🏫 Mentorship from YC-backed teams

​🧋 Free boba at Campus kickoff!!

​Extras for winners:

​1:1 office hours with top VCs

​1:1 YC application mentorship from founders in recent YC batches

​Winners get 1 free startup legal consultation sessions from Magstone Law (magstonelaw.com)

​💰 PRIZE POOL: $5,000 GUARANTEED, UP TO $10,000 For every 100 attendees, we add $1,000 to the pool, up to $10,000. Invite your friends to apply and grow the pot!

​🏆 AWARDS (share of the final prize pool)

​Grand Champion: 30% ($1,500–$3,000)

​Real Customer Award: 20% ($1,000–$2,000), VC 1:1

​Distribution & Impact: 20% ($1,000–$2,000)

​School Cup: 20% ($1,000–$2,000), shared among the winning school's winning teams and its school ambassador

​Best Build Log: 10% ($500–$1,000), shared among the top five

​⚖️ JUDGES Judges include YC founders and builders from Microsoft, OpenAI, and Perplexity.

​Full judge lineup coming soon.

​🎓 WHO CAN JOIN

​Stanford and Berkeley students and alumni

​Industry experts from enterprise AI teams who can bring real-world problems. We'll match experts with student and alumni teams.

​Please apply with your school or work email if you have one; a personal email is fine otherwise.

​⚙️ ABOUT HARNESSROUTER HarnessRouter is a unified interface for agent harnesses that turns them into building blocks for your AI product. Ship production-ready AI features in hours, with no harness engineering, no deployment hassle, and no complex integration across models, harnesses, and sandboxes. By picking the best harness × model combination for each task, it can cut token costs by over 90%. Past hackathon builders shipped in hours and got their first paying customer within a week.

​⚙️ ABOUT MagStone Law LLP

​MagStone Law LLP helps turn big ideas into real companies. From launching your first startup to raising venture capital and scaling your business, we guide founders through every stage of their entrepreneurial journey. We also help venture capital firms build funds and invest in the next generation of startups.

​⚙️ ABOUT Tokenrouter

​TokenRouter is a unified AI API gatewaydesigned by PaleBlueDot AI that consolidates over 70 multimodal frontier models (covering text, image, video, and audio) into a single API layer. Instead of maintaining separate integrations and individual billing accounts for every AI provider, developers use one API key and a standardized request format

​Organized by HarnessRouter Labs (YC-backed). Sponsored by MagStone Law LLP、OppyAI Inc.

About Event
​Venture Mindset Hackathon - Reinvent Yourself in SF - builders, founders and judges: GSB/MSx, YC ...

​⏰ Doors open at 11:00 AM sharp.
🚪 Entry closes at 11:15 AM or once we’re full — come early!

​🚀 Join us on January 17 (Sat), 2026 in downtown SF for a one-day Hackathon focused on bold ideas, teamwork, and innovation.

​Participants create a clear vision of who they want to become in 10 years — not in a linear way, but in an exponential, ambitious way, similar to how venture investors think about long-term growth.

​✨ Why it matters:

​GSB/MSx alumni will see how the younger generation learns to think in true Stanford GSB style — with courage, long-term vision, and strategic imagination.

​✅ Challenge:
Create the ultimate AI sales copilot!
This hackathon is for developers, product managers, sales engineers, marketers, and AI enthusiasts who want to reinvent how sales teams work using AI.

​🔧 Choose the sales pain point you want to solve:

​qualifying and prioritizing leads,

​automating repetitive follow-ups,

​optimizing sales funnels,

​or giving teams real-time AI coaching during calls.

​🎯 The main goal is to build a working app or prototype that empowers sales teams, saves time, and drives measurable revenue impact.

​

​

​🗓️ Schedule

​10:00 AM | Doors Open & Breakfast Networking
10:55 AM | Doors Close (or earlier if capacity is reached)
11:00 AM | Team Kick-Off
11:15 AM | Hacking Starts
1:30 PM | 🍴 Delicious Lunch Break (our special feature!)
4:00 PM | Final Demos (2 min per team + 1 Q&A)
5:00 PM | Networking
6:00 PM | Doors Close

​🏆 Prizes

​1st Place - $30k ** + TBA

​2nd Place - $20k ** + TBA

​3rd Place - $10k ** +TBA

​(**Prizes via equity through FAST Advisory Agreement; see disclaimer - **.)

Our judges are selection-only and chosen through a thorough 2-step interview process. Last time, we received 65 applications — it’s a tough and competitive selection. Please, Apply here to become a judge

​Judges’ participation does not imply endorsement of any team, product, or technology.

​👉 If you truly have something to bring to the table, or can help us by sponsoring the event, we’d love to hear from you.

​

​✅ Mentors- TBA:
